en.html: I hated him. Because I hated him, I would kill him. This was revenge. This man had killed Muramasa. He had killed her, so I would kill him back. Simple justice. Quite natural. So I would kill him. So—◆ So—◆ But... This perfectly natural revenge... Had I ever allowed anybody else to take it?
en.text:
I hated him.

Because I hated him, I would kill him.

This was revenge.

This man had killed Muramasa.
He had killed her, so I would kill him back.

Simple justice. Quite natural.

So I would kill him.

So—◆
So—◆

But...

This perfectly natural revenge...
Had I ever allowed anybody else to take it?

ja.html: 憎い。 　憎いから、殺す。 　これは復讐だ。 　村正はこの男に殺された。 　殺されたから、殺し返す。 　当然の法だ。 　だから、殺す。 　だから、◆ 　だから、◆ 　 　だが、 　俺は、 　その当然の復讐を、誰かに許した事があるだろうか？
ja.text:
憎い。

　憎いから、殺す。

　これは復讐だ。

　村正はこの男に殺された。

　殺されたから、殺し返す。

　当然の法だ。

　だから、殺す。

　だから、◆
　だから、◆
　
　だが、

　俺は、
　その当然の復讐を、誰かに許した事があるだろうか？

en.html:
So many people I had killed. So many.
How many times that number had grieved for them?

How many wanted revenge on the man who killed them?

Not one of them had got it. The proof was standing here. I was still alive.

Revenge on me, not allowed. My own revenge, full permission to kill?
How would that work?

ja.html:
何人も、何人も殺してきた。
　その死を深く悲しんだ人の数は、幾倍になるだろう。

　どれ程の人が、殺害者への復讐を望んでいるだろう。

　だがその中の誰一人、宿願を遂げてはいない。
　俺がこうして生きているのだから。

　自分への復讐を許さない俺が、自分の復讐で誰かを
殺せるのか。

en.html: Kageaki(I want to kill him.)

With everything in me, I wanted it.
I hated the man who had taken Muramasa away.

But was this man the only one who had killed her?

In a way, what Sorimachi had done was revenge. He hated my killings. He wanted to make me pay.

I had started it.

I had made this man kill Muramasa.

ja.html:
深く思う。
　村正を奪った男が、余りにも憎い。

　だが――村正を殺したのは、<ruby>この男だけ<rt>・・・・・</rt></ruby>なのか。

　雪車町のした事はある意味、復讐だ。
　俺の殺人を憎み、俺への報復を望んだ。

　俺が契機だ。

　俺がこの男に、村正を殺させた。

en.html: Still that thought stayed. I wanted to kill this man. It was by this man's hand that Muramasa had been killed! Kill him. I could. Right and wrong could go to hell. I was already a murderer, soaked in blood. Women, children, old people—I had killed them all. And now one petty thug whose only contribution was taking up space in the world, him I could not kill? I could. Without hesitating, I could. As I had done all this time. I could kill him.◆ But—◆ All those people I had killed before... I had wanted to contain the disaster. I had believed that killing the one person before me would prevent the deaths of many others. That was why I had killed. Yuhi Nitta.◆ Fuki and Funa.◆ Suguru Oji.◆ Major Gargett.◆ Hikaru also. That was why I had killed them.
en.text:
Still that thought stayed.
I wanted to kill this man.

It was by this man's hand that Muramasa had been killed!

Kill him.
I could.

Right and wrong could go to hell. I was already a murderer, soaked in blood.

Women, children, old people—I had killed them all. And now one petty thug whose only contribution was taking up space in the world, him I could not kill?

I could.
Without hesitating, I could.

As I had done all this time.

I could kill him.◆
But—◆

All those people I had killed before...

I had wanted to contain the disaster.

I had believed that killing the one person before me would prevent the deaths of many others.

That was why I had killed.

Yuhi Nitta.◆ Fuki and Funa.◆
Suguru Oji.◆ Major Gargett.◆


Hikaru also.

That was why I had killed them.

ja.html: そうして尚、思う。 　この男を殺したい。 　この男の手で村正が殺されたのだから！ 　殺す。 　殺せる。 　事の理非など知らぬ。 　俺は元より、血に浸つかった殺人鬼。 　女子供老人に至るまで殺してきたのだ。 　今更、こんな世間の場所塞ぎのようなちんぴらを、 殺せない筈があろうか。 　殺せる。 　迷いなく殺せる。 　これまでやってきたように。 　殺せる。◆ 　だが。◆ 　 　過去、俺が人を殺したのは―― 　災いを封じたかったから。 　目の前の一人を殺すことで、大勢の人の死が未然に 防がれると信じたから。 　――だから殺した。 　新田雄飛も、◆ふきとふなも。◆ 　皇路卓も、◆ガーゲット少佐も。◆ 　 　光も。 　だから殺したのだ。
ja.text:
そうして尚、思う。
　この男を殺したい。

　この男の手で村正が殺されたのだから！

　殺す。
　殺せる。

　事の理非など知らぬ。
　俺は元より、血に浸つかった殺人鬼。

　女子供老人に至るまで殺してきたのだ。
　今更、こんな世間の場所塞ぎのようなちんぴらを、
殺せない筈があろうか。

　殺せる。
　迷いなく殺せる。

　これまでやってきたように。

　殺せる。◆
　だが。◆
　
　過去、俺が人を殺したのは――

　災いを封じたかったから。

　目の前の一人を殺すことで、大勢の人の死が未然に
防がれると信じたから。

　――だから殺した。

　新田雄飛も、◆ふきとふなも。◆
　皇路卓も、◆ガーゲット少佐も。◆
　

　光も。

　だから殺したのだ。

en.html: Back to the beginning. I remembered the road I had chosen. Kill people in the pursuit of peace. That was the road I stood on. And now? If I killed this man, who would be saved? Nobody. Only my own wish for revenge would be satisfied. ...Even then, could I kill him? Could I—◆ just to settle my own hatred—◆ just to save myself—◆ take somebody's life? Could I do that?
en.text:
Back to the beginning.
I remembered the road I had chosen.

Kill people in the pursuit of peace.
That was the road I stood on.

And now?

If I killed this man, who would be saved?

Nobody.

Only my own wish for revenge would be satisfied.

...Even then, could I kill him?

Could I—◆
just to settle my own hatred—◆
just to save myself—◆
take somebody's life?

Could I do that?

ja.html: その原点―― 　己が選んだ道を思い出す。 　人を殺して平和を求める・・・・・・・・・・・。 　そんな道に、俺は立っていたのだ。 　今は、どうか。 　この男を殺して、誰が救われるだろう。 　誰も救われない。 　俺の復讐心が満たされるだけ。 　……それでも殺せるか。 　俺は、◆ 　俺の憎しみを晴らし、◆ 　俺自身を救うためだけに、◆ 　人の命を奪えるか。 　奪えるのか。
ja.text:
その原点――
　己が選んだ道を思い出す。

　人を殺して平和を求める・・・・・・・・・・・。
　そんな道に、俺は立っていたのだ。

　今は、どうか。

　この男を殺して、誰が救われるだろう。

　誰も救われない。

　俺の復讐心が満たされるだけ。

　……それでも殺せるか。

　俺は、◆
　俺の憎しみを晴らし、◆
　俺自身を救うためだけに、◆
　人の命を奪えるか。

　奪えるのか。
